# FORMA³

> FORMA³ is a custom 3D modeling studio. Our main focus is commissioned work: we build custom 3D models for games, brands, advertising, AR/VR and 3D printing — with a concept, moodboard and exact quote delivered within 48 hours, starting from 9,000 ₽ (~$99). We also sell a catalog of ready-made 3D models with commercial licenses (GLB, FBX, OBJ) and offer a free in-browser 3D viewer.

The site is available in 11 languages via URL prefix (ru, en, es, de, pl, tg, kk, fa, ar, ko, zh). English pages are linked below; swap the `/en` prefix for any other locale code.

## Services

- [Order a custom 3D model](https://forma3d-studio.netlify.app/en/order): the core service — brief in 5 minutes, online price calculator, concept in 48 hours. Hard-surface and organic modeling, characters with rigging, product visualization, optimized 3D for the web (Three.js/WebGL).
- [Catalog of ready-made models](https://forma3d-studio.netlify.app/en/works): 10 ready 3D models with commercial licenses, each viewable in 3D right in the browser.
- [3D Lab — free online viewer](https://forma3d-studio.netlify.app/en/lab): open GLB, GLTF, FBX, OBJ and STL files locally in the browser; files never leave the device.
